sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.22/2024 was registered by Kalaburagi Women Police Station, Kalaburagi for the aforesaid offences against Shankar and others on the basis of the first information dated 16.05.2024 received from respondent No.2, who is the wife of accused No.1 - Shankar.

The petitioners herein,
who are the mother and sisters of accused No.1 are arrayed as accused Nos.2 to 4 in the FIR.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against four persons.
The petitioners are arraigned as accused Nos.2 to 4 in the charge sheet.
The Trial Court after taking cognizance of the charge sheeted offences has issued summons to the accused.
Being aggrieved by the same, petitioners are before this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are the mother and sisters of accused No.1 and they are all staying separately.
He submits that false and omnibus allegations have been made against the petitioners only to harass and embarrass them.
He also submits that no specific allegations are made against the petitioners, which would attract the alleged offences as against them.
Hence, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 and learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 have opposed the petition.
They submit that after completing the investigation, charge sheet has been already filed and therefore, it is not a fit case for exercising the powers under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, they pray to dismiss the petition.

6. Perusal of the averments made in the FIR would reveal that the marriage of accused No.1 with respondent No.2 was solemnized on 15.12.2022 and after the NC: 2025:KHC-K:76 marriage,
accused No.1 and his wife were residing together at Hyderabad.
In the first information, allegation of assault on the first informant in her parents' house at Chittapur in Kalaburagi is only as against accused No.1, who is her husband.
There are no specific allegations as against accused Nos.2 to 4 in the first information and only omnibus allegations are found against them.

Further statement of the first informant was recorded by the police on 16.05.2024 and even in the said statement, the first informant has stated that after the marriage, she and her husband were residing separately at Hyderabad.

She has stated that on 01.05.2024, she had returned to her parents' house at Chittapur and on the said date, at about 6.00 p.m., accused No.1 asked her to give him divorce and had left her in her parents house and returned to Hyderabad.
She has stated that subsequently there was a panchayat held and she was sent back to Hyderabad along with her husband.
It is her specific case that her husband was not taking care of her even thereafter in Hyderabad and therefore, she had returned to her parents' house and had approached the police.

Therefore, it is evident that after the alleged incident that had taken place on 01.05.2024 in the parents house of the first informant, the matter was settled in a panchayat and first informant had returned to Hyderabad and she was staying along with her husband.

The allegation in the first information is Durgamma And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54623967/
3 that even thereafter her husband was not taking care of her and therefore, she had approached the police.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no allegation whatsoever against the petitioners herein that they had come to Hyderabad and had abused or assaulted the first informant.

There is no any such allegation made against them that they have committed any such act at Hyderabad after the first informant had joined her husband pursuant to panchayat held, which would prima facie attract the charge sheeted offences against them.

The material on record would go to show that accused No.2 is the mother of accused No.1 and accused Nos.3 and 4 are married sisters of accused No.1 and they are all residing separately along with their family members.

By making omnibus allegations against the relatives of accused No.1,
they are all sought to be arraigned as accused in the impugned criminal case, which cannot be permitted.
In the event impugned criminal proceedings is allowed to continue as against the petitioners, the same would amounts to abuse of process of law.
Under the circumstances, it is just and necessary to quash the same.

Accordingly, following order is passed:
ORDER
The criminal petition is allowed.

The entire proceedings in C.C.No.4723/2024 pending before the Court of II JMFC, Kalaburagi arising out of Crime No.22/2024 registered by Kalaburagi Women Police Station, Kalaburagi for the offences punishable under NC: 2025:KHC-K:76 Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC as against petitioners stand quashed.
